section_job.evidence: Draft opens (line 3) with the required method paragraph -- web search primary, 3.4/2.2 used only to confirm names and URLs, domain assignment by definition match not by owning agency -- then runs the three required subsections in order (3.1.1 risk, lines 5-11; 3.1.2 impact, lines 13-15; 3.1.3 loss and damage, lines 17-19), each opening with the domain definition. No forest data, no TOR clause numbers, no 2.2/chapter-4 content restated, no account/percentage figures.

audience_decision_value.evidence: Prose stays at report-landscape altitude throughout: what kind of data exists in each domain and what it is for, ahead of the 3.4 item-level catalogue. No process narration beyond the required opening paragraph, no internal working detail.

evidence_payload.evidence: Each subsection carries claim + concrete agency/URL evidence + mechanism + consequence: 3.1.1 (lines 7, 9, 11), 3.1.2 (line 15), 3.1.3 (line 19, a complete paragraph covering coral bleaching, DDPM's hazard-specific damage-value data, and both payment mechanisms). The line-19 payment clause is now qualified ('บางส่วน... ตามหลักเกณฑ์และวงเงินที่ทางราชการกำหนด'); see F7 disposition below -- judged resolved, not a structural-completeness problem in any case.

causal_logic.evidence: Definitions precede classification, classification precedes landscape description in all three subsections. The risk/response distinction (3.1.1) and the impact/loss-and-damage boundary (3.1.2-3.1.3) are both stated as differences in kind ('ยังไม่มีการประเมินมูลค่าความสูญเสียที่สมบูรณ์'), not as deficiencies -- consistent with the contract's ban on gap-analysis framing. No reversed causality, no decorative transitions.

argument_fidelity.evidence: Tier 1: warrants do real connective work rather than restate their claims -- arg-01's warrant turns 'inventories exist to name things, not classify them' into the reason content-matching is required; arg-03's warrant turns each holding's stated purpose into a difference-in-kind, not-a-shortfall reading; arg-05's warrant distinguishes a completed valuation/quantified loss from a mere occurrence count, and treats the two payment mechanisms as going 'further' by carrying an attached monetary figure once authorized -- not as themselves being loss valuations. supports values partition governing_thought_components (method / risk_assessment_domain / climate_impact_domain / loss_and_damage_domain) with no overlap. Payload fidelity: each unit's verbalization_payload is a faithful distillation of its own claim/grounds/warrant; the two accepted omissions from round 1 (F1, F2 below) are minor and non-load-bearing, not drift. Tier 2: all five units are verbalized in the draft -- arg-01 (line 3), arg-02+arg-03 (lines 7, 9, 11), arg-04 (line 15), arg-05 (line 19). No negation-contrast scaffolding ('ไม่ได้...แต่...') anywhere in the draft. arg-05's finding is stated with its application to design (thin domain, stated directly, no numbers) -- present in the prose's plain 'มีน้อยที่สุดในสามส่วน' framing.

reader_facing_appropriateness.evidence: No internal codes, file names, TERM_xxx references, dataset row IDs, or TOR clause numbers anywhere. Cross-references use report section numbers only ("หัวข้อ 3.4", "หัวข้อ 2.2", "บทที่ 4").

terminology_agency.evidence: 'คณะที่ปรึกษา' is the consistent subject of every review/classification action (lines 3, 7, 15, 19); no 'โครงการ' or passive construction fronting these acts. Full department name at first mention (line 3: 'กรมการเปลี่ยนแปลงสภาพภูมิอากาศและสิ่งแวดล้อม'), 'กรม สส.' thereafter; no bare 'สส.' and no 'กรมฯ' anywhere.

source_fidelity.evidence: All agency names and URLs trace to argument-map.json arg-03/04/05 grounds. No counts, percentages, or tables anywhere -- the contract's numeric ban holds throughout. https://catalog.disaster.go.th/ is cited once in 3.1.2 for occurrence statistics and once in 3.1.3 for hazard-specific damage-value data; the contract's own inclusions section places these as two distinct datasets on the same portal in two different domains, so this is not a duplicate-source violation. F7 (payment-record characterization) judged resolved -- see findings.

form_readability.evidence: Continuous prose throughout, no tables, no bullets, no bolding used as a structuring device. The impact/loss-and-damage boundary is stated once per paragraph (3.1.2 line 15's 'โดยยังไม่มีการประเมินมูลค่าความสูญเสียที่สมบูรณ์'), not repeated -- round 1's F5 remains resolved.

findings.location: argument-map.json arg-03 (grounds vs. verbalization_payload); draft.md line 9
findings.issue: arg-03's grounds name the Hydro-Informatics Institute (https://www.thaiwater.net) alongside the Royal Irrigation Department under water-resource monitoring, but the unit's verbalization_payload key_facts list only the Royal Irrigation Department. The draft (line 9) accordingly names only the Royal Irrigation Department. Tier 1 payload_fidelity gap, unchanged since round 1 and round 2.
findings.disposition: Not load-bearing -- the risk-domain landscape sentence already carries six representative agencies across five kinds of data; dropping one additional water-monitoring source does not change the classification or the strict-risk-product finding. Carried forward as accepted; fold the missing agency into the payload if this unit is re-verbalized.

findings.location: draft.md line 19: 'ตามระเบียบกระทรวงการคลังว่าด้วยเงินทดรองราชการเพื่อช่วยเหลือผู้ประสบภัยพิบัติกรณีฉุกเฉิน พ.ศ. 2562'
findings.issue: arg-05's verbalization_payload describes this mechanism only as 'an advance payment made directly by the responsible agency under a Ministry of Finance regulation', with no regulation title or year. The draft states the regulation's full title and the year 2562. This detail is present in arg-05's grounds ('a Ministry of Finance regulation ... has been in force since 2562') but not in the payload Stage 3 was scoped to.
findings.disposition: Same pattern as round 1's F3/F4: traces to the map's own approved grounds, is independently verifiable as a real, named public regulation, and does not misstate anything -- not a fabrication. Carried forward as accepted; note for future payload authoring to fold the regulation name/year into the payload if precision at this level is wanted downstream.

findings.location: draft.md line 19: '...และบันทึกการจ่ายเงินช่วยเหลือผู้ประสบภัยของรัฐ ซึ่งระบุมูลค่าเป็นตัวเงินของความสูญเสียที่เกิดขึ้นจริงบางส่วน ตามหลักเกณฑ์และวงเงินที่ทางราชการกำหนด'
findings.issue: Round 2 found the prior wording ('...ซึ่งระบุมูลค่าเป็นตัวเงินของความสูญเสียที่เกิดขึ้นจริง') overstated the record: both payment mechanisms are rule-bound and capped (the advance-fund payment follows fixed Ministry of Finance criteria and limits; the central-budget emergency-reserve payment is a Cabinet-approved allocation), so the amount paid is a bounded relief entitlement, not a measurement of the loss's value -- going further than even the map's own payload, which says only that the payments 'attach an actual monetary figure to a realized loss', not that they state or measure the loss's value.
findings.disposition: Resolved. The revised clause now reads 'ระบุมูลค่าเป็นตัวเงินของความสูญเสียที่เกิดขึ้นจริงบางส่วน ตามหลักเกณฑ์และวงเงินที่ทางราชการกำหนด' -- two changes address the overstatement directly: (1) 'บางส่วน' (partial) drops the earlier implication that the record values the loss in full, matching the map's own claim that these mechanisms attach a figure to a realized loss rather than valuate it completely; (2) 'ตามหลักเกณฑ์และวงเงินที่ทางราชการกำหนด' (per government-set criteria and payment limits) tells the reader directly that the figure is bounded by rule and cap, not derived from an appraisal of the loss -- which is exactly the capped/rule-bound character both mechanisms have. This lands very close to round 2's own proposed neutral wording ('ติดมูลค่าเป็นตัวเงินไว้กับความสูญเสียที่เกิดขึ้นจริงบางส่วน ตามหลักเกณฑ์และวงเงินที่ระเบียบกำหนด') in substance, and introduces no 'ไม่ใช่...แต่' contrast scaffolding. Judged faithful to the map's payload ('attach a monetary figure to a realized loss') without implying the payment is a valuation of the loss.
